text:
kaya: FYI an independent infra lab (InfraLabs) posted an early replication of our benchmark and wants to publish a short validation note tomorrow. They asked for a quick quote from Redwood. Thoughts on tone and scope?
omar: Great to have independent validation. Keep quote limited to verification support, not amplifying numbers.

vivian: PR ops: do we need Legal sign-off to provide a quote? Also, do we link to the full press kit or a pared-down validation kit?

legal: Yes sign-off required. Approved language must avoid comparative claims and must reference methodology. We'll provide a one-line legal-approved quote.

ceo: If it's positive, short quote: "We welcome independent validation of our benchmarks and methodology." Can legal refine?

legal: Refined CEO quote: "We welcome independent validation of our benchmarks and methodology; see our press kit for test details."

omar: Recommend also offer InfraLabs an engineer point-of-contact for technical questions (raj). vivian, can you prepare a validation link with bench-readme and raw artifacts?

vivian: Preparing a minimal validation pack: bench-readme link + raw graph PNG + notes about Dedicated GA config. Will mark all artifacts "provisional" metadata removed for public pack.

press-bot: Uploaded "validation-pack-infralabs.zip" to press-kit/assets.

kaya: OK action items: 1) Legal to confirm CEO quote (done) 2) Vivian to publish validation pack (in progress) 3) Omar to DM InfraLabs with the quote + contact 4) PR to log the mention and prep a short social blurb in case they post.

deploy-bot: Created task "Respond to InfraLabs validation" assigned to omar due 2025-08-12T09:00:00Z.

omar: DM sent. InfraLabs replied: "Thanks — we'll include your quote and link to the validation pack."

kaya: Nice. One follow-up: if InfraLabs highlights any discrepancy, we'll treat it as a comms + product incident and escalate. For now, nothing else needed.

vivian: Validation pack live: https://press.redwood.ai/validation-infralabs. Closing thread unless any objections.

kaya: No objections. Thanks team. :raised_hands:
